reviews.title: Eh
reviews.comment:
[Employee of bestbuy] After installing cooler to a b650 motherboard. The display came on and actually cooled my Ryzen 5 7600x fairly great. 
After installing the software to so I could add gifs to its LCD display. It would repeatedly say it could not recognize the display for customization.
For some couple hours of troubleshooting including: reinstalling AIO - redownloading software - configuring pin placement - researching similar user issues. We came to a conclusion this AIO cooler was….defective.
Although it did half its job, we ultimately decided to exchange this model for the NZXT Kraken Elite 360mm so that we can have the feature of a customizable LCD display.
